CORAM Dr. Neela Gokhale, J.

DATED: 3rd NOVEMBER 2025  PC:-
 1.

By way of this application, the Applicant seeks his  release on bail in connection with FIR No. 564 of 2022 dated  30th September 2022 registered with Panvel City Police  Station, for the offfence punishable under Section 363 of the  Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short, "IPC").
Thereafter, the  offence under Section 376 of the IPC was also added.
2. The facts of the case, in brief, are that the mother of th  victim is the First Informant.

She has stated that her daughter,

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: According to her statement, her daughter was  lured to run away with the Applicant.
Thereafter, in the  supplementary statement, the First Informant states that on  27th October 2022, her daughter was found with the  Applicant, who was their neighbor's nephew, at Nashik.
She  further stated that when her daughter was found, her  daughter informed her that she met the said Applicant in  August-September 2022 and that they were in a relationship  since then.
Her daughter also told her that they had been to a  Mahadev temple and had exchanged garlands and she  believed that they were married.
At that time, said victim  namely the daughter of the First Informant conveyed to her  mother that the Applicant had forcible sexual intercourse with  her.
3. The Applicant then filed an application for bail before  the District and Sessions Court, Panvel.
However, by order  dated 10th May 2023, the bail application was rejected.

sentences.text: Thereafter, the Applicant has filed the present Bail Application  through jail.
During the pendency of the present Bail  Application, he also filed another bail application before the  Trial Court which was also rejected by order dated 17 th  December 2024.
The present application is thus before this  Court today.

4. Since the Bail Application has been filed through jail,
 this Court had appointed Mr. Piyush Toshnival, learned  Advocate, to represent the Applicant and Mr. Sushant Mhatre,
 learned Advocate, to represent Respondent No.2.
5. I have heard all the parties and perused the record with  their assistance.
Ms. Megha Bajoria, learned APP, has drawn  my attention to the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
I have perused the said statement.
The victim has clearly stated that she was in a relationship  with the said Applicant and that she had gone away with him  on her own will.
She has also stated that the sexual  relationship between them was consensual.

Be that as it may,

 6.

sentences.text:
Mr. Toshnival, learned Counsel for the Applicant,
 submits that the Applicant was arrested on 28 th October 2022  and till date, the charges are not framed.
Since the Applicant  is a young person of less than 21 years of age, no purpose  would be served by his continued incarceration in jail.
It is  undesirable that the Applicant be forced to associate with  hardened criminals for a continued period.
Considering that  the charges are not framed till date, it is highly unlikely that  the trial will conclude within a near future.
Ganesh
